description: Proposes updates to the container images pinned in the role defaults. Runs every Saturday from .github/workflows/renovate.yml; nothing is merged automatically.

customManagers.description: The Renovate image the workflow runs (.github/renovate-image). Major tag only: 44.x releases arrive at every run, a new major comes as a normal PR.

packageRules.description: Immich: server and Valkey in one PR; read the release notes before merging

Postgres major versions (Immich's tag follows the Immich release; every major needs a dump and restore): listed under Pending Approval in the Dependency Dashboard and in the Telegram message, never opened as a PR. Do the upgrade by hand; do not tick the box.

The workflow's runner image (runs-on) and any action it may use: the job's GITHUB_TOKEN cannot edit workflow files, so only new majors are listed under Pending Approval. Change the version in the workflow by hand; do not tick the box.
Minor, patch and digest updates in the workflow file: not worth a manual change every week.
